## Posts

- [Building AI-Promptable Full-Stack Apps with TanStack Start](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/building-ai-promptable-fullstack-apps/): A reproducible full-stack architecture for AI-promptable web apps with TanStack Start, three-layer schemas, swappable interfaces, and Agent Skills.

- [Isolated Integration Tests with pytest-scenarios](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/pytest-scenarios-isolated-integration-tests/): Use pytest-scenarios to create isolated integration test data that cleans itself up automatically.

- [TanStack Router: Opinionated Guidelines for Production React Apps](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/tanstack-router-opinionated-conventions-production-react-apps/): Based on real-world experience in shipping complex applications, this guide delivers the best practices you need to master modern React development and ship high-quality, scalable applications. Perfect for developers looking to optimize React performance and application architecture.

- [Easily creating a golang command line tool](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/create-cmd-tool-golang/): Let's see how to easily and quickly create a command line tool in golang

- [Parameterized Tests in Cypress](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/cypress-parametrized-dynamic-tests/): How to write parameterized tests in Cypress

- [Golang over Java for REST services](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/rest-service-go-vs-java/): Why I'd pick Golang over Java to create any new distributed system. I am going to compare a REST service implementation in Java vs the implementation in Golang

- [Create a PWA with Create React App: Lessons Learned](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/pwa-lessons-learned-cra/): Lessons learned while developing a PWA with CRA: Budget Tracker

- [Create SPA with React + Typescript + Parcel](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/react-typescript-parcel/): Example project how to create a Single Page Application with React, Typescript and Parcel.

- [Custom Maven Plugin - Override default build lifecycle](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/creating-custom-maven-plugin-default/): How to create a custom Maven plugin which overrides default build lifecycle

- [Example how to create custom Maven Plugin](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/creating-custom-maven-plugin/): Example to understand Maven plugins concepts and how to create a custom Maven plugin from scratch

- [Choosing a Modern C++ stack](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/choosing-modern-cpp-stack/): Why I'd choose Meson+Doctest tech stack to create a new C++ project with a reusable and easy-to-run example.

- [Filesystem in C++17](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/recursive-directory-iterator/): We are going to analyze with examples new filesystem features coming with C++17

- [Multi-Domain Docker Containers](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/reverse-proxy-multidomain-docker/): How to create different Docker containers with different domain names in the same host

- [Convert files formats - Windows to Unix](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/recursive-dos-unix/): Convert Windows formatted files to Unix format per directory recursively

- [REST URLs](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/rest-urls/): Design REST API: URLs

- [Build C++ project with Gradle](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/gradle-cpp/): How to build a C++ project using Gradle

- [Embedded Java Databases - Performance Comparison](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/java-embedded-db-performance-comparison/): Performance comparison in Java between three embedded databases like Derby/JavaDB, Sqlite, and ObjectDB

- [Java serialization ways: Performance Comparison](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/serialization-java-serializable-externalizable/): Java serialization ways, performance comparison

- [Mutex C++](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/cpp-mutex/): Mutex wrapper on C++98 pthread mutex and a the better C++11 std::mutex solution

- [Android Studio Portable Download](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/android-studio-portable-download/): Link to download Android Studio Portable

- [Debugging library generated with libtool](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/debug-libtool-lib/): How to debug a library generated with libtool

- [C++ Struct memory alignment](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/cpp-pragma-pack/): Understanding pragma pack preprocessor directive and how it affects to memory alignment

- [Git Proxy Configuration](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/git-proxy-config/): Quick guide to configure Git to work through HTTP/HTTPS proxies

- [Replace punctuation symbols in Python](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/remove-replace-punctuation-py/): An example of how to remove or replace punctuation symbols of a Python string

- [Text Normalization in Python](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/normalize-text-py/): Avoiding problems with texts containing non-ASCII characters

- [Remove HTML Tags](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/delete-html-tags-py-django/): How to remove HTML tags using Python or even easier, using Django

- [Remove orphaned packages (Linux)](https://carlosvin.github.io/pr-preview/pr-133/linux-remove-orphaned-files/): How to remove unused packages in Linux
